def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    base = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    win_30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    win_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    win_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)

    items = db["order_items"]
    hist_items = items[items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    if not hist_items.empty:
        hist_items["in_30d"] = (hist_items["ts"] >= win_30).astype(int)
        hist_items["in_90d"] = (hist_items["ts"] >= win_90).astype(int)
        hist_items["in_180d"] = (hist_items["ts"] >= win_180).astype(int)

    # --------------------------
    # 1. Order Items Aggregations
    # --------------------------
    order_agg = pd.DataFrame()
    if not hist_items.empty:
        g = hist_items.groupby("product_id")
        order_agg = pd.DataFrame({
            "total_units_alltime": g.size(),
            "total_units_180d": g["in_180d"].sum(),
            "total_units_90d": g["in_90d"].sum(),
            "total_units_30d": g["in_30d"].sum(),
            "total_revenue_alltime": g["price"].sum(),
            "total_revenue_90d": g.apply(
                lambda d: d.loc[d["in_90d"] == 1, "price"].sum()),
            "avg_price_alltime": g["price"].mean(),
            "avg_freight_90d": g.apply(
                lambda d: d.loc[d["in_90d"] == 1, "freight_value"].mean()
                if (d["in_90d"] == 1).any() else 0.0),
            "unique_sellers_alltime": g["seller_id"].nunique(),
            "last_sale_ts": g["ts"].max(),
        })
        order_agg["days_since_last_sale"] = (
            seed_time - order_agg["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
        order_agg = order_agg.drop(columns=["last_sale_ts"])

    # --------------------------
    # 2. Product-Order Links
    # --------------------------
    product_order_links = pd.DataFrame()
    if not hist_items.empty:
        product_order_links = hist_items[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()

    # --------------------------
    # 3. Review Aggregations (review known only if review_creation_date < seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    review_agg = pd.DataFrame()
    if not product_order_links.empty:
        reviews = db["reviews"]
        hist_reviews = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
        if not hist_reviews.empty:
            review_product = hist_reviews.merge(product_order_links, on="order_id", how="inner")
            if not review_product.empty:
                g = review_product.groupby("product_id")
                review_agg = pd.DataFrame({
                    "avg_review_score": g["review_score"].mean(),
                    "total_reviews": g.size(),
                    "last_review_ts": g["review_creation_date"].max(),
                })
                review_agg["days_since_last_review"] = (
                    seed_time - review_agg["last_review_ts"]).dt.days
                review_agg = review_agg.drop(columns=["last_review_ts"])

    # --------------------------
    # 4. Order Status (only orders purchased before seed_time; canceled status
    #    counted only for orders old enough that the status was already set)
    # --------------------------
    order_status_agg = pd.DataFrame()
    if not product_order_links.empty:
        orders = db["orders"]
        known_orders = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time][
            ["order_id", "order_status", "order_purchase_timestamp"]].copy()
        pos = product_order_links.merge(known_orders, on="order_id", how="inner")
        if not pos.empty:
            # статус мог быть проставлен позже покупки: считаем отмену известной
            # только если с момента покупки прошло >= 14 дней
            pos["is_canceled_known"] = (
                (pos["order_status"] == "canceled") &
                (pos["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=14))
            ).astype(int)
            g = pos.groupby("product_id")
            order_status_agg = pd.DataFrame({
                "total_orders_alltime": g["order_id"].nunique(),
                "canceled_orders": g["is_canceled_known"].sum(),
            })
            order_status_agg["canceled_rate"] = (
                order_status_agg["canceled_orders"] /
                order_status_agg["total_orders_alltime"].replace(0, np.nan))
            order_status_agg = order_status_agg.drop(columns=["canceled_orders"])

    # --------------------------

    # --------------------------
    delivery_agg = pd.DataFrame()

            delivered["delivery_delay_days"] = (

                delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
            prod_del = product_order_links.merge(
                delivered[["order_id", "delivery_delay_days"]], on="order_id", how="inner")

                g = prod_del.groupby("product_id")
                delivery_agg = pd.DataFrame({
                    "avg_delivery_delay": g["delivery_delay_days"].mean(),
                    "total_delivered_orders": g.size(),

                avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),

            product_pay = product_order_links.merge(order_pay_agg, on="order_id", how="inner")
            if not product_pay.empty:
                g = product_pay.groupby("product_id")
                pay_agg = pd.DataFrame({
                    "avg_total_order_payment": g["total_order_payment"].mean(),
                    "avg_payment_installments": g["avg_installments"].mean(),
                    "total_orders_with_payment": g.size(),
                })

    # --------------------------
    # 7. Sales Activity
    # --------------------------
    activity_agg = pd.DataFrame()
    if not hist_items.empty:
        sale_dates = hist_items.groupby("product_id")["ts"].agg(["min", "max"])
        sale_dates.columns = ["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"]

    # Merge

    result = base.copy()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time: pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Extract tables from database
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    
    # Step 1: Filter all data to strictly historical (no leakage beyond seed_time)
    # Filter order_items first to get valid order_ids (purchased on/before seed_time)
    filtered_order_items = order_items[order_items["ts"] <= seed_time].copy()
    valid_order_ids = filtered_order_items["order_id"].unique()
    
    # Filter other tables to valid orders AND historical timestamps
    filtered_orders = orders[orders["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids)].copy()
    filtered_reviews = reviews[
        reviews["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids) & 
        (reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time)
    ].copy()
    filtered_payments = payments[
        payments["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids) & 
        (payments["ts"] <= seed_time)
    ].copy()
    
    # Initialize output DataFrame indexed by input entity_ids
    output = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))
    
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Core Order Items Features (sales volume, pricing, timing)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Aggregate core stats from order_items
    order_items_agg = filtered_order_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_sold=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        first_sale_ts=("ts", "min"),
        last_sale_ts=("ts", "max")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Compute time-based features
    order_items_agg["days_since_first_sale"] = (
        (seed_time - order_items_agg["first_sale_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    )
    order_items_agg["days_since_last_sale"] = (
        (seed_time - order_items_agg["last_sale_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    )
    order_items_agg["sales_frequency"] = (
        order_items_agg["total_units_sold"] / order_items_agg["days_since_first_sale"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    
    # Helper to get rolling window sales counts
    def get_window_sales(window_days):
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window_days)
        return filtered_order_items[
            filtered_order_items["ts"] >= cutoff
        ].groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count().rename(f"units_sold_last_{window_days}d")
    
    # Compute rolling window features
    for window in [30, 90, 180, 365]:
        order_items_agg = order_items_agg.merge(get_window_sales(window), on="product_id", how="left")
    
    # Compute average days between consecutive sales
    def compute_avg_sale_interval(group):
        if len(group) < 2:
            return np.nan
        sorted_ts = group["ts"].sort_values()
        intervals = sorted_ts.diff().dropna()
        return intervals.dt.total_seconds().mean() / (24 * 3600)
    
    avg_sale_intervals = filtered_order_items.groupby("product_id").apply(
        compute_avg_sale_interval
    ).rename("avg_days_between_sales").reset_index()
    order_items_agg = order_items_agg.merge(avg_sale_intervals, on="product_id", how="left")
    
    # Merge order_items features to output
    output = output.join(order_items_agg.set_index("product_id"), how="left")
    
    # Fill NaN values for products with no sales history
    fill_core = {
        "total_units_sold": 0, "total_orders": 0, "total_sellers": 0,
        "total_revenue": 0.0, "total_freight": 0.0, "avg_price": 0.0,
        "avg_freight": 0.0, "days_since_first_sale": 730.0,
        "days_since_last_sale": 730.0, "sales_frequency": 0.0,
        "units_sold_last_30d": 0, "units_sold_last_90d": 0,
        "units_sold_last_180d": 0, "units_sold_last_365d": 0,
        "avg_days_between_sales": 730.0
    }
    output.fillna(value=fill_core, inplace=True)
    output.drop(columns=["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"], inplace=True, errors="ignore")
    
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Order Status & Delivery Features
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Merge order items with orders data
    order_items_orders = filtered_order_items.merge(filtered_orders, on="order_id", how="left")
    
    # Order status counts and ratios
    status_counts = order_items_orders.groupby(["product_id", "order_status"])["order_id"].nunique().unstack(fill_value=0)
    status_ratios = status_counts.div(status_counts.sum(axis=1), axis=0).fillna(0)
    status_counts.columns = [f"order_count_{s}" for s in status_counts.columns]
    status_ratios.columns = [f"order_ratio_{s}" for s in status_ratios.columns]
    order_status_features = pd.concat([status_counts, status_ratios], axis=1).reset_index()
    
    # Delivery performance for delivered orders
    delivered = order_items_orders[order_items_orders["order_status"] == "delivered"].copy()
    if len(delivered) > 0:
        delivered["delivery_days"] = (
            (delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"] - delivered["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
        )
        delivered["is_late"] = delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"] > delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
        delivery_agg = delivered.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_delivery_days=("delivery_days", "mean"),
            pct_late_deliveries=("is_late", "mean")
        ).reset_index()
    else:
        delivery_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id", "avg_delivery_days", "pct_late_deliveries"])
    
    order_features = order_status_features.merge(delivery_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    output = output.join(order_features.set_index("product_id"), how="left")
    
    # Global defaults for delivery features
    global_delivery_days = 14.0
    global_late_pct = 0.1
    if len(filtered_orders[filtered_orders["order_status"] == "delivered"]) > 0:
        global_delivery_days = (
            (filtered_orders[filtered_orders["order_status"] == "delivered"]["order_delivered_customer_date"]
             - filtered_orders[filtered_orders["order_status"] == "delivered"]["order_purchase_timestamp"])
            .dt.total_seconds() / (24*3600)
        ).mean()
        global_late_pct = (
            filtered_orders[filtered_orders["order_status"] == "delivered"]["order_delivered_customer_date"]
            > filtered_orders[filtered_orders["order_status"] == "delivered"]["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
        ).mean()
    
    fill_order = {}
    for col in output.columns:
        if col.startswith("order_count_") or col.startswith("order_ratio_"):
            fill_order[col] = 0
    fill_order["avg_delivery_days"] = global_delivery_days if not np.isnan(global_delivery_days) else 14.0
    fill_order["pct_late_deliveries"] = global_late_pct if not np.isnan(global_late_pct) else 0.1
    output.fillna(value=fill_order, inplace=True)
    
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Review Features
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Merge order items with reviews
    order_items_reviews = filtered_order_items.merge(filtered_reviews, on="order_id", how="left")
    
    # Core review aggregates
    review_agg = order_items_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_id", "count"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        max_review_score=("review_score", "max")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # 5-star and 1-star review ratios
    five_star = order_items_reviews[order_items_reviews["review_score"] == 5].groupby("product_id")["review_id"].count().rename("five_star")
    one_star = order_items_reviews[order_items_reviews["review_score"] == 1].groupby("product_id")["review_id"].count().rename("one_star")
    review_agg = review_agg.merge(five_star, on="product_id", how="left").merge(one_star, on="product_id", how="left")
    review_agg["five_star_ratio"] = review_agg["five_star"] / review_agg["total_reviews"].replace(0, np.nan)
    review_agg["one_star_ratio"] = review_agg["one_star"] / review_agg["total_reviews"].replace(0, np.nan)
    review_agg.drop(columns=["five_star", "one_star"], inplace=True)
    
    output = output.join(review_agg.set_index("product_id"), how="left")
    
    # Global defaults for review features
    global_avg_rev = 3.0
    global_min_rev = 1.0
    global_max_rev = 5.0
    if len(filtered_reviews) > 0:
        global_avg_rev = filtered_reviews["review_score"].mean()
        global_min_rev = filtered_reviews["review_score"].min()
        global_max_rev = filtered_reviews["review_score"].max()
    
    fill_review = {
        "total_reviews": 0, "avg_review_score": global_avg_rev,
        "min_review_score": global_min_rev, "max_review_score": global_max_rev,
        "five_star_ratio": 0.0, "one_star_ratio": 0.0
    }
    output.fillna(value=fill_review, inplace=True)
    
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Payment Features
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Aggregate payments per order first
    order_payments = filtered_payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        num_payments=("payment_sequential", "count")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Pivot payment type counts per order
    if len(filtered_payments) > 0:
        payment_types = filtered_payments.pivot_table(
            index="order_id", columns="payment_type", values="payment_sequential",
            aggfunc="count", fill_value=0
        )
        payment_types.columns = [f"pay_type_{c}" for c in payment_types.columns]
        order_payments = order_payments.merge(payment_types, on="order_id", how="left").fillna(0)
    else:
        # No payments: add dummy columns to avoid errors
        order_payments["pay_type_unknown"] = 0
    
    # Merge with order items, then aggregate per product
    order_items_pay = filtered_order_items.merge(order_payments, on="order_id", how="left")
    pay_agg = order_items_pay.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_total_payment=("total_payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("avg_installments", "mean"),
        avg_payments_per_order=("num_payments", "mean")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Compute payment type ratios per product
    pay_type_cols = [c for c in order_payments.columns if c.startswith("pay_type_")]
    pay_type_totals = order_items_pay.groupby("product_id")[pay_type_cols].sum().reset_index()
    total_pay_counts = pay_type_totals[pay_type_cols].sum(axis=1)
    for col in pay_type_cols:
        pay_type_totals[f"{col}_ratio"] = pay_type_totals[col] / total_pay_counts.replace(0, np.nan)
    pay_type_totals.drop(columns=pay_type_cols, inplace=True)
    pay_agg = pay_agg.merge(pay_type_totals, on="product_id", how="left")
    
    output = output.join(pay_agg.set_index("product_id"), how="left")
    
    # Global defaults for payment features
    global_avg_pay = 0.0
    global_avg_inst = 1.0
    global_avg_pay_count = 1.0
    if len(order_payments) > 0:
        global_avg_pay = order_payments["total_payment_value"].mean()
        global_avg_inst = order_payments["avg_installments"].mean()
        global_avg_pay_count = order_payments["num_payments"].mean()
    
    fill_pay = {
        "avg_total_payment": global_avg_pay,
        "avg_installments": global_avg_inst,
        "avg_payments_per_order": global_avg_pay_count
    }
    for col in output.columns:
        if col.startswith("pay_type_") and col.endswith("_ratio"):
            fill_pay[col] = 0.0
    output.fillna(value=fill_pay, inplace=True)
    
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final cleanup: ensure numeric types, reindex to input entity_ids
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Convert all integer columns to float64 for consistent dtype handling
    for col in output.columns:
        if pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(output[col]):
            output[col] = output[col].astype(np.float64)
    
    # Strictly reindex to input entity_ids (guarantees correct order and coverage)
    output = output.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    return output

    filtered_order_items = order_items[order_items["ts"] <= seed_time].copy()
    valid_order_ids = filtered_order_items["order_id"].unique()

    filtered_orders = orders[orders["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids)].copy()
    filtered_reviews = reviews[
        reviews["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids)
        & (reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time)
    ].copy()
    filtered_payments = payments[
        payments["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids)
        & (payments["ts"] <= seed_time)
    ].copy()

    output = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    # ---- 1. Core order item features ----
    agg = filtered_order_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_sold=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        first_sale_ts=("ts", "min"),
        last_sale_ts=("ts", "max"),
    ).reset_index()

    agg["days_since_first_sale"] = (
        (seed_time - agg["first_sale_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400
    )
    agg["days_since_last_sale"] = (
        (seed_time - agg["last_sale_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400
    )
    agg["sales_frequency"] = agg["total_units_sold"] / agg[
        "days_since_first_sale"
    ].replace(0, np.nan)

    def window_sales(window_days):
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window_days)
        return filtered_order_items[
            filtered_order_items["ts"] >= cutoff
        ].groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count().rename(
            f"units_sold_last_{window_days}d"
        )

    for window in [30, 90, 180, 365]:
        agg = agg.merge(window_sales(window), on="product_id", how="left")

    def avg_interval(group):
        if len(group) < 2:
            return np.nan
        intervals = group["ts"].sort_values().diff().dropna()
        return intervals.dt.total_seconds().mean() / 86400

    intervals = filtered_order_items.groupby("product_id").apply(
        avg_interval
    ).rename("avg_days_between_sales").reset_index()
    agg = agg.merge(intervals, on="product_id", how="left")

    output = output.join(agg.set_index("product_id"), how="left")

    fill_core = {
        "total_units_sold": 0, "total_orders": 0, "total_sellers": 0,
        "total_revenue": 0.0, "total_freight": 0.0, "avg_price": 0.0,
        "avg_freight": 0.0, "days_since_first_sale": 730.0,
        "days_since_last_sale": 730.0, "sales_frequency": 0.0,
        "units_sold_last_30d": 0, "units_sold_last_90d": 0,
        "units_sold_last_180d": 0, "units_sold_last_365d": 0,
        "avg_days_between_sales": 730.0,
    }
    output.fillna(value=fill_core, inplace=True)
    output.drop(columns=["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"], inplace=True, errors="ignore")

    # ---- 2. Order status & delivery features (status as of seed_time) ----
    oi_orders = filtered_order_items.merge(filtered_orders, on="order_id", how="left")

    # Reconstruct status known at seed_time from timestamps (order_status column
    # reflects the *current* status and would leak future info).
    delivered_cust = oi_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"]
    delivered_carrier = oi_orders["order_delivered_carrier_date"]
    approved = oi_orders["order_approved_at"]
    purchase = oi_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"]

    status = np.where(
        delivered_cust.notna() & (delivered_cust <= seed_time), "delivered",
        np.where(
            delivered_carrier.notna() & (delivered_carrier <= seed_time), "shipped",
            np.where(
                approved.notna() & (approved <= seed_time), "approved",
                np.where(purchase.notna() & (purchase <= seed_time), "purchased", "unknown"),
            ),
        ),
    )
    oi_orders["status_at_seed"] = status

    status_counts = oi_orders.groupby(["product_id", "status_at_seed"])[
        "order_id"
    ].nunique().unstack(fill_value=0)
    status_ratios = status_counts.div(status_counts.sum(axis=1), axis=0).fillna(0)
    status_counts.columns = [f"order_count_{s}" for s in status_counts.columns]
    status_ratios.columns = [f"order_ratio_{s}" for s in status_ratios.columns]
    order_status_features = pd.concat([status_counts, status_ratios], axis=1).reset_index()

    # Delivery performance: only orders DELIVERED BEFORE seed_time
    delivered = oi_orders[
        (oi_orders["status_at_seed"] == "delivered")
        & (delivered_cust <= seed_time)
    ].copy()
    if len(delivered) > 0:
        delivered["delivery_days"] = (
            delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
            - delivered["order_purchase_timestamp"]
        ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400
        delivered["is_late"] = (
            delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
            > delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
        )
        delivery_agg = delivered.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_delivery_days=("delivery_days", "mean"),
            pct_late_deliveries=("is_late", "mean"),
        ).reset_index()
    else:
        delivery_agg = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["product_id", "avg_delivery_days", "pct_late_deliveries"]
        )

    order_features = order_status_features.merge(delivery_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    output = output.join(order_features.set_index("product_id"), how="left")

    # Global defaults computed only from orders delivered before seed_time
    global_delivery_days = 14.0
    global_late_pct = 0.1
    glob_delivered = filtered_orders[
        filtered_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
        & (filtered_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] <= seed_time)
    ]
    if len(glob_delivered) > 0:
        global_delivery_days = (
            (glob_delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
             - glob_delivered["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400
        ).mean()
        global_late_pct = (
            glob_delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
            > glob_delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
        ).mean()
        if np.isnan(global_delivery_days):
            global_delivery_days = 14.0
        if np.isnan(global_late_pct):
            global_late_pct = 0.1

    fill_order = {
        col: 0 for col in output.columns
        if col.startswith("order_count_") or col.startswith("order_ratio_")
    }
    fill_order["avg_delivery_days"] = global_delivery_days
    fill_order["pct_late_deliveries"] = global_late_pct
    output.fillna(value=fill_order, inplace=True)

    # ---- 3. Review features (only reviews created before seed_time) ----
    oi_reviews = filtered_order_items.merge(filtered_reviews, on="order_id", how="left")

    review_agg = oi_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_id", "count"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        max_review_score=("review_score", "max"),
    ).reset_index()

    five_star = oi_reviews[oi_reviews["review_score"] == 5].groupby("product_id")[
        "review_id"
    ].count().rename("five_star")
    one_star = oi_reviews[oi_reviews["review_score"] == 1].groupby("product_id")[
        "review_id"
    ].count().rename("one_star")
    review_agg = review_agg.merge(five_star, on="product_id", how="left").merge(
        one_star, on="product_id", how="left"
    )
    review_agg["five_star_ratio"] = review_agg["five_star"] / review_agg[
        "total_reviews"
    ].replace(0, np.nan)
    review_agg["one_star_ratio"] = review_agg["one_star"] / review_agg[
        "total_reviews"
    ].replace(0, np.nan)
    review_agg.drop(columns=["five_star", "one_star"], inplace=True)

    output = output.join(review_agg.set_index("product_id"), how="left")

    global_avg_rev, global_min_rev, global_max_rev = 3.0, 1.0, 5.0
    if len(filtered_reviews) > 0:
        global_avg_rev = filtered_reviews["review_score"].mean()
        global_min_rev = filtered_reviews["review_score"].min()
        global_max_rev = filtered_reviews["review_score"].max()

    output.fillna(value={
        "total_reviews": 0,
        "avg_review_score": global_avg_rev,
        "min_review_score": global_min_rev,
        "max_review_score": global_max_rev,
        "five_star_ratio": 0.0,
        "one_star_ratio": 0.0,
    }, inplace=True)

    # ---- 4. Payment features (only payments with ts <= seed_time) ----
    order_payments = filtered_payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        num_payments=("payment_sequential", "count"),
    ).reset_index()

    if len(filtered_payments) > 0:
        payment_types = filtered_payments.pivot_table(
            index="order_id", columns="payment_type",
            values="payment_sequential", aggfunc="count", fill_value=0,
        )
        payment_types.columns = [f"pay_type_{c}" for c in payment_types.columns]
        order_payments = order_payments.merge(
            payment_types, on="order_id", how="left"
        ).fillna(0)

    oi_pay = filtered_order_items.merge(order_payments, on="order_id", how="left")
    pay_agg = oi_pay.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_total_payment=("total_payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("avg_installments", "mean"),
        avg_payments_per_order=("num_payments", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()

    pay_type_cols = [c for c in order_payments.columns if c.startswith("pay_type_")]
    if pay_type_cols:
        pay_type_totals = oi_pay.groupby("product_id")[pay_type_cols].sum().reset_index()
        total_pay_counts = pay_type_totals[pay_type_cols].sum(axis=1)
        for col in pay_type_cols:
            pay_type_totals[f"{col}_ratio"] = pay_type_totals[col] / total_pay_counts.replace(0, np.nan)
        pay_type_totals.drop(columns=pay_type_cols, inplace=True)
        pay_agg = pay_agg.merge(pay_type_totals, on="product_id", how="left")

    output = output.join(pay_agg.set_index("product_id"), how="left")

    global_avg_pay, global_avg_inst, global_avg_pay_count = 0.0, 1.0, 1.0
    if len(order_payments) > 0:
        global_avg_pay = order_payments["total_payment_value"].mean()
        global_avg_inst = order_payments["avg_installments"].mean()
        global_avg_pay_count = order_payments["num_payments"].mean()

    fill_pay = {
        "avg_total_payment": global_avg_pay,
        "avg_installments": global_avg_inst,
        "avg_payments_per_order": global_avg_pay_count,
    }
    for col in output.columns:
        if col.startswith("pay_type_") and col.endswith("_ratio"):
            fill_pay[col] = 0.0
    output.fillna(value=fill_pay, inplace=True)

    # ---- final cleanup ----
    for col in output.columns:
        if pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(output[col]):
            output[col] = output[col].astype(np.float64)

    output = output.reindex(entity_ids)
    return output

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Unpack tables
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    
    # Base dataframe with requested product IDs
    base = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids})
    seed_month = seed_time.month
    seed_quarter = (seed_month - 1) // 3 + 1
    
    # 1. Preprocess historical order items (all data before seed_time)
    hist_order_items = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    if not hist_order_items.empty:
        # Add time window flags
        window_days_list = [7, 30, 90, 180, 365]
        for wd in window_days_list:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=wd)
            hist_order_items[f"in_last_{wd}d"] = hist_order_items["ts"] >= cutoff
        
        # 1a. Recency feature
        last_sale = hist_order_items.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max().reset_index(name="last_sale_ts")
        last_sale["recency_days"] = (seed_time - last_sale["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
        last_sale = last_sale.drop(columns=["last_sale_ts"])
        base = base.merge(last_sale, on="product_id", how="left")
        
        # 1b. All-time order items aggregates
        all_time_agg = hist_order_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            total_units_sold=("order_id", "count"),
            total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
            avg_price=("price", "mean"),
            std_price=("price", "std"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            std_freight=("freight_value", "std")
        ).reset_index()
        all_time_agg["avg_items_per_order"] = all_time_agg["total_units_sold"] / all_time_agg["total_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
        base = base.merge(all_time_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
        
        # 1c. Windowed order items aggregates
        for wd in window_days_list:
            window_col = f"in_last_{wd}d"
            if window_col in hist_order_items.columns:
                window_data = hist_order_items[hist_order_items[window_col]]
                if not window_data.empty:
                    w_agg = window_data.groupby("product_id").agg(
                        **{
                            f"orders_last_{wd}d": ("order_id", "nunique"),
                            f"units_sold_last_{wd}d": ("order_id", "count"),
                            f"revenue_last_{wd}d": ("price", "sum"),
                            f"avg_price_last_{wd}d": ("price", "mean"),
                            f"freight_last_{wd}d": ("freight_value", "sum")
                        }
                    ).reset_index()
                    base = base.merge(w_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
        
        # 2. Order-level features (delivery, status)
        hist_orders_items = hist_order_items.merge(orders, on="order_id", how="left")
        if not hist_orders_items.empty:
            hist_orders_items["delivery_delay_days"] = (hist_orders_items["order_delivered_customer_date"] - hist_orders_items["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.days
            hist_orders_items["delivery_time_days"] = (hist_orders_items["order_delivered_customer_date"] - hist_orders_items["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days
            hist_orders_items["is_delivered"] = (hist_orders_items["order_status"] == "delivered").astype(int)
            
            order_features = hist_orders_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
                share_delivered_orders=("is_delivered", "mean"),
                avg_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "mean"),
                std_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "std"),
                avg_delivery_time=("delivery_time_days", "mean"),
                std_delivery_time=("delivery_time_days", "std")
            ).reset_index()
            base = base.merge(order_features, on="product_id", how="left")
        
        # 3. Review features
        hist_reviews = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time].copy()
        if not hist_reviews.empty:
            # Link reviews to products via order_items
            reviews_with_product = hist_reviews.merge(
                hist_order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
                on="order_id",
                how="inner"
            )
            if not reviews_with_product.empty:
                reviews_with_product["has_comment"] = (
                    ~reviews_with_product["review_comment_title"].isna() | 
                    ~reviews_with_product["review_comment_message"].isna()
                ).astype(int)
                reviews_with_product = reviews_with_product.merge(
                    orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]],
                    on="order_id",
                    how="left"
                )
                reviews_with_product["time_to_review_days"] = (
                    reviews_with_product["review_creation_date"] - reviews_with_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]
                ).dt.days
                
                review_features = reviews_with_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
                    avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
                    total_reviews=("review_id", "count"),
                    share_5star_reviews=("review_score", lambda x: (x == 5).mean()),
                    share_1star_reviews=("review_score", lambda x: (x == 1).mean()),
                    share_commented_reviews=("has_comment", "mean"),
                    avg_days_to_review=("time_to_review_days", "mean")
                ).reset_index()
                base = base.merge(review_features, on="product_id", how="left")
        
        # 4. Payment features
        hist_payments = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
        if not hist_payments.empty:
            # Aggregate per order first
            order_payment_agg = hist_payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
                total_order_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
                num_payment_methods=("payment_type", "nunique"),
                avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
                share_credit_card=("payment_type", lambda x: (x == "credit_card").mean()),
                share_boleto=("payment_type", lambda x: (x == "boleto").mean())
            ).reset_index()
            # Link to products
            product_payments = hist_order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates().merge(
                order_payment_agg,
                on="order_id",
                how="inner"
            )
            if not product_payments.empty:
                payment_features = product_payments.groupby("product_id").agg(
                    avg_order_payment=("total_order_payment", "mean"),
                    avg_payment_methods_per_order=("num_payment_methods", "mean"),
                    avg_installments_per_order=("avg_installments", "mean"),
                    share_orders_credit_card=("share_credit_card", "mean"),
                    share_orders_boleto=("share_boleto", "mean")
                ).reset_index()
                base = base.merge(payment_features, on="product_id", how="left")
    
    # 5. Add global/seed time features and clean up
    # Recency fillna for products with no history
    base["recency_days"] = base["recency_days"].fillna(9999)
    # Has history flag
    base["has_history"] = (base["total_units_sold"].fillna(0) > 0).astype(int)
    # Seed time features
    base["seed_month"] = seed_month
    base["seed_quarter"] = seed_quarter
    # Fill remaining NaNs with 0
    base = base.fillna(0)
    # Set index and reindex to input entity_ids
    base = base.set_index("product_id").reindex(entity_ids)
    
    return base

import pandas as pd

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]

    payments = db["payments"]

    base = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": list(entity_ids)})

    hist_order_items = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    if not hist_order_items.empty:
        window_days_list = [7, 30, 90, 180, 365]
        for wd in window_days_list:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=wd)
            hist_order_items[f"in_last_{wd}d"] = hist_order_items["ts"] >= cutoff

        # Recency
        last_sale = hist_order_items.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max().reset_index(name="last_sale_ts")
        last_sale["recency_days"] = (seed_time - last_sale["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
        last_sale = last_sale.drop(columns=["last_sale_ts"])
        base = base.merge(last_sale, on="product_id", how="left")

        # All-time aggregates
        all_time_agg = hist_order_items.groupby("product_id").agg(

            total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
            avg_price=("price", "mean"),

            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            std_freight=("freight_value", "std")
        ).reset_index()
        all_time_agg["avg_items_per_order"] = all_time_agg["total_units_sold"] / all_time_agg["total_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
        base = base.merge(all_time_agg, on="product_id", how="left")

        # Windowed aggregates
        for wd in window_days_list:
            window_col = f"in_last_{wd}d"
            window_data = hist_order_items[hist_order_items[window_col]]
            if not window_data.empty:
                w_agg = window_data.groupby("product_id").agg(
                    **{
                        f"orders_last_{wd}d": ("order_id", "nunique"),
                        f"units_sold_last_{wd}d": ("order_id", "count"),
                        f"revenue_last_{wd}d": ("price", "sum"),
                        f"avg_price_last_{wd}d": ("price", "mean"),
                        f"freight_last_{wd}d": ("freight_value", "sum")
                    }
                ).reset_index()
                base = base.merge(w_agg, on="product_id", how="left")

        # Order-level features: only info known by seed_time
        hist_orders_items = hist_order_items.merge(orders, on="order_id", how="left")

        # Delivery info known only if delivery already happened before seed_time
        delivered_mask = hist_orders_items["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna() & \
                         (hist_orders_items["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
        delivered_rows = hist_orders_items[delivered_mask].copy()
        if not delivered_rows.empty:
            delivered_rows["delivery_delay_days"] = (delivered_rows["order_delivered_customer_date"] - delivered_rows["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.days
            delivered_rows["delivery_time_days"] = (delivered_rows["order_delivered_customer_date"] - delivered_rows["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days

            delivery_features = delivered_rows.groupby("product_id").agg(
                avg_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "mean"),
                std_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "std"),
                avg_delivery_time=("delivery_time_days", "mean"),
                std_delivery_time=("delivery_time_days", "std")
            ).reset_index()
            base = base.merge(delivery_features, on="product_id", how="left")

            delivered_counts = delivered_rows.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().reset_index(name="delivered_orders")
            base = base.merge(delivered_counts, on="product_id", how="left")
            base["share_delivered_orders"] = base["delivered_orders"] / base["total_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
            base = base.drop(columns=["delivered_orders"])

        # Reviews: only reviews already answered before seed_time
        hist_reviews = reviews[reviews["review_answer_timestamp"] < seed_time].copy()
        if not hist_reviews.empty:
            reviews_with_product = hist_reviews.merge(
                hist_order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
                on="order_id",
                how="inner"
            )
            if not reviews_with_product.empty:
                reviews_with_product["has_comment"] = (
                    ~reviews_with_product["review_comment_title"].isna() |
                    ~reviews_with_product["review_comment_message"].isna()
                ).astype(int)
                reviews_with_product = reviews_with_product.merge(
                    orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]],
                    on="order_id",
                    how="left"
                )
                reviews_with_product["time_to_review_days"] = (
                    reviews_with_product["review_creation_date"] - reviews_with_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]
                ).dt.days

                review_features = reviews_with_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
                    avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
                    total_reviews=("review_id", "count"),
                    share_5star_reviews=("review_score", lambda x: (x == 5).mean()),
                    share_1star_reviews=("review_score", lambda x: (x == 1).mean()),
                    share_commented_reviews=("has_comment", "mean"),
                    avg_days_to_review=("time_to_review_days", "mean")
                ).reset_index()
                base = base.merge(review_features, on="product_id", how="left")
